summary_en: 220,000 shares (2.34% of S/O ex-treasury) acquired via N-NET3 立会外 block trade. Upper limit ¥139.04M at ¥632/share (2026-08-20 close). Settlement 2026-08-21 08:45 JST.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via N-NET3 off-exchange block trading
translation_en_brief: JB Eleven's board of directors resolved on 2026-08-20 to acquire up to 220,000 treasury shares (2.34% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a total outlay of ¥139.04M via N-NET3 off-exchange block trading. The purchase order will be placed at 08:45 JST on 2026-08-21 at the Nagoya Stock Exchange, executing at the previous day's closing price of ¥632/share. The filing states this acquisition responds to changes in the operating environment by enabling more flexible capital allocation. Results will be announced immediately after the 08:45 execution window. As of 2026-08-20, the company held 47,950 treasury shares against 9,402,550 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
